To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the noisy training of DNNs is an effective way to improve DNN performance in speech recognition, especially in adverse acoustic conditions.

(1) noisy training can significantly improve the performance of DNN-based automatic speech recognition (ASR); (2) the amount of noise injected should be controlled to avoid over-fitting; (3) the noisy training approach is effective in both clean and noise environments; (4) the noisy training can be combined with other techniques to improve ASR performance further.

noisy training can significantly improve DNN-based speech recognizer’s robustness in the presence of high ambient noise, and that the performance of DNN-based speech recognizers can be further improved by combining noisy training and feature-space augmentation techniques.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the training process of deep neural networks can be improved for better performance in adverse acoustic environments.
how to train a DNN model to achieve robustness against noise in the training data, and the proposed noisy training approach provides a simple and effective way to achieve this goal.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
noisy training can be used to improve the performance of DNNs, especially when the training data are limited.

the noisy training technique can be a very powerful tool for training DNN models, especially in the case when the training data are not clean enough, which is a typical scenario for speech recognition.
the noisy training is a very promising technique for improving the robustness of DNNs in speech recognition.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the noisy training technique, as a generalization of the conventional data augmentation technique, can be applied to the DNN-based speech recognizer and can significantly improve its performance.
noisy training is a simple but very effective technique for DNNs, which is also applicable to other machine learning tasks.

the noisy training can help to reduce over-fitting of the DNN model, which is a common issue for the DNN-based speech recognisers, and hence to improve the robustness against adverse acoustic conditions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the DNN model, like other machine learning models, can benefit from the noisy training technique.
the noisy training can be a powerful tool to improve the generalization of DNN models.
the DNN model is not as robust as the conventional Gaussian mixture model (GMM) in noisy environments, but can be improved by the noisy training.
